Selected red/blue CRT twin from cabinet photo, not alternate projection cabinet. Flyer corroborates hardware and pedal/twin geometry, but its black guns and red left-side artwork are not mixed into the selected cyan/pink-gun blue-side reference.
One blue photographed side is repeated readably on both sides; the unseen opposite factory print is unverified, not invented. Small text is only an impression at sprite resolution.

Two actual Time Crisis II photographed attract displays are individually rectified and letterboxed, not substituted gameplay or claimed local captures. Photo reflections and fine screen detail persist.

Two holstered/tethered pistols, two modeled trigger details and two separate floor pedals are physical art geometry, not mounted machine guns or joystick/button panels. Cords and tread are simplified at native scale; recoil and pedal motion are not animated.
The control reference has opposite pink/cyan placement; only its original-design center instruction plaque is used. Selected cabinet photo determines cyan P1 / pink P2 gun color.

64x64 canvas accommodates the wider twin. Floor depth is compressed 0.55x and station width 0.9x about the shared cell center to keep projecting pedals within the existing bottom-center anchor in all rotations; proportions are a sprite-scale adaptation, not dimensionally exact. Both boards/screens share one editor object; leave neighboring floor space. No map placement, emulation changes or uploads.
